idea-plugin.name: Subscription ACP Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Use your Claude Pro or Max subscription in JetBrains AI chat. No Anthropic API key, no JetBrains AI credits, no manual npm setup.

Adds a Claude Subscription agent to the AI Assistant chat. It runs @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp, the official Claude adapter for the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), built on the Claude Agent SDK that powers Claude Code. You sign in with your Claude.ai account.

Why this plugin

The Claude agent bundled with the IDE runs on JetBrains AI credits or an Anthropic API key. It is launched with --hide-claude-auth, which removes the subscription sign-in and rejects subscription credentials with "This integration does not support using claude.ai subscriptions", shown in chat as "Authentication was reset. Please create a new chat for the change to take effect." This plugin registers the same package as a local ACP agent without that flag. Nothing is patched: the package supports subscription sign-in by default.

What you get

  • Install and restart. The agent is added to ~/.jetbrains/acp.json for you, merged with your other agents, with a backup of the original file.
  • Sign in with the standard Claude.ai Pro/Max login. No API key.
  • Node.js is found automatically: the IDE's own runtime, nvm, fnm, Volta, asdf, mise, vfox, nodenv or Homebrew, and the official installer or nvm-windows on Windows.
  • A settings page, Settings → Tools → Subscription ACP Agent, with a model dropdown that lists the models your plan offers.
  • Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, RubyMine, RustRover and CLion 2026.2 and 2026.3, and Android Studio on 2026.2.
  • Open source, MIT licensed.

Requirements

  • The JetBrains AI Assistant plugin
  • A Claude Pro or Max subscription
  • Node.js, which is usually already present

FAQ

How is this different from the Claude agent bundled with the IDE? The bundled agent runs on JetBrains AI credits or an Anthropic API key. This one signs in with your Claude.ai subscription.

How is this different from installing the ACP adapter with npm myself? It is the same package. The plugin removes the global npm install and the hand-edited agent config, and it pins a tested package version that moves forward with plugin updates.

Does it consume JetBrains AI credits? No. The agent runs under your own Claude subscription.

Unofficial community plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or JetBrains. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic.
